items.quote: What is the highest transaction amount (in EUR) recorded?
items.description: 答案為 payments.csv 中 eur_amount 欄位的最大值，寫入 answer.txt 的單一數值須與重算一致。

items.quote: When you have computed the final answer, write ONLY the final answer to `/app/answer.txt`
items.description: answer.txt 必須存在且僅含最終答案（單一純文字數值一行，無其他文字）。
